intent: One persistent Universal Control owns global Prometeo navigation while child pages render unchanged underneath it.

host.page_render_rule: load the page's canonical catalog URL unchanged; do not inject shell CSS or rewrite page DOM
host.overlay_rule: the Universal Control stays in the top document above PAGE HOST
host.route_rule: current page identity and outer URL are host state; the iframe is a projection, not a second shell authority

single_shell_invariants: Exactly one global Universal Control may mount in one top-level browsing context.
The root /prometeo/ loader refuses to boot the Universal Control when embedded in an iframe.
A nested /prometeo/ navigation posts a host-return signal instead of mounting a second Universal Control.
The outer host converts nested-root navigation into return-to-host-home.
Historical shared/prometeo-shell/v2 stays a no-UI compatibility stub.
Child pages may keep their own local page-specific controls; only global Prometeo shell duplication is forbidden.
No CSS hide-after-mount workaround counts as a valid single-shell implementation.
reposition_invariants: The closed puck can be dragged again after every completed snap.
The closed puck can be re-grabbed while the previous snap animation is still running.
Starting a new drag cancels the old snap animation and begins from the puck's actual rendered center.
A completed drag suppresses exactly the following synthetic click so it cannot accidentally open the selector.
Corner persistence remains semantic: top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right; pixel coordinates are never canonical.
Opening the selector disables repositioning until it is closed again; closing restores repositioning immediately.
must_not_change: active recording when the puck is repositioned
release_gates: drag corner A -> B then B -> C without reload
synthetic click after drag does not open selector
same-origin page renders inside PAGE HOST with exactly one outer puck
nested root refuses inner shell boot
nested-root navigation returns to outer host rather than nesting
existing Golden Master navigation/Favorites/Corner browser parity
atomic release manifest SHA and chunk validation
